title: Break In 2 Randox Hub OP Mobile
features:
Features
1. WalkSpeed / JumpPower
Adjust player speed and jump height with sliders and toggles.

2. Noclip & Floating
Pass through walls or float in place with toggleable options.

3. Item Spawner
Spawn weapons (crowbar, bat, hammer, etc.), food (pizza, golden apple), keys, armor, and utility items.

4. Teleport System
Teleport to 15+ locations including Home, Boss Fight, Shop, Kitchen, Golden Apple, NPCs (Dog, Agent Bradley, Uncle Pete), and Secret Ending spots.

5. Combat

Kill all enemies (loopable)

Break enemies (set health to 0)

Bring enemies to your position (loopable)

6. Heal & Buffs

Heal yourself (single or loop)

Heal all players (single or loop)

Train Strength/Speed

Semi‑Godmode (protects from special attacks)

7. Game Breaking

Delete The House, The Game, Boss Room, Vending Machines, etc.

Delete/Freeze/Kill other players (limbs, body, clothes, accessories, hair, face, hats)

Remove weather effects (wind, ice, hail, mud) for everyone

Delete enemies, NPCs, and bosses instantly

8. Badge Unlocks
One‑click unlock for Dream Team, Dog Rescue, Wake Up Bradley!, Uncle Pete’s Return, Golden Apple, Delivery’s Here, Reformed, and more.

9. Auto Functions

Auto collect cash (toggle)

Auto claim Uncle Pete quests

Auto heal (loop)

Hidden items ESP

Full Bright

10. Miscellaneous

Equip/Unequip all tools

Break fallen trees

Damage yourself (custom amount)

Instant proximity prompts

Fire click detectors / touch interests

Teleport to private lobby

11. Utility Scripts

Load Infinite Yield directly from the hub

Load Dex Explorer

Delete any model, folder, or part by name
